e:
Well-demarcated erythematous swelling = cellulitis/erysipelas (Strep pyogenes ± S. aureus) → Amoxycillin-clavulanate covers both.
Metronidazole = anaerobes/protozoa only.

Pemphigus vulgaris: flaccid, easily ruptured bullae c̅ suprabasal acantholysis (anti-Dsg3 ± Dsg1).
Foliaceous = split in granular layer; vegetans = flexural vegetations.
Type 1 lepra reaction c̅ nerve involvement: continue MDT (ALT) + start prednisolone to prevent nerve damage.

Type 1 (reversal) reaction: inflammation of existing lesions + nerve pain/tenderness during MDT.
ENL (type 2) = new tender nodules c̅ fever.
Pellagra (niacin deficiency): photosensitive dermatitis (Casal's necklace) c̅ the 3 Ds – Dermatitis, Diarrhoea, Dementia.
Phrynoderma = follicular hyperkeratosis over elbows/knees of Vit A deficiency; night blindness (nyctalopia) supports it.
Kerion: boggy, tender, pustular scalp swelling c̅ hair loss = inflammatory tinea capitis → oral griseofulvin/terbinafine.
p-Phenylenediamine (PPD) = hair-dye allergen → allergic contact dermatitis (type IV hypersensitivity).
Isotretinoin/antibiotic-resistant acne in a woman → evaluate for hyperandrogenism (e.g. PCOS).

Painless indurated genital ulcer + non-tender inguinal nodes = primary syphilis (chancre).
Chancroid = painful ulcer c̅ tender bubo.
Pigmented papillomatous/nevoid lesions carry ↑ risk of malignant melanoma.
Dermatitis herpetiformis: itchy extensor vesicles c̅ celiac disease; granular IgA at dermal papillary tips on DIF → dapsone + gluten-free diet.

Stable hypopigmented patch c̅ Wood's lamp accentuation and negative diascopy → nevus depigmentosus.
Nevus anemicus = vascular, disappears on diascopy.
Lupus vulgaris (cutaneous TB) is paucibacillary → PCR is the most sensitive/specific confirmatory test here.

Foot swelling + sinuses + black granules = eumycetoma → KOH shows slender septate dematiaceous hyphae.
Actinomycetoma = thin branching filamentous bacteria.
